Title: Saie Hello To Beauty’s Favourite Brand

URL Source: https://becauseofmarketing.substack.com/p/saie-hello-to-beautys-favourite-brand

Published Time: 2026-10-14T08:13:53+00:00

Markdown Content:
[![Image 1](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!LcXD!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F51169bb0-7b71-4cab-8d0c-ed3cfdf7ab06_1200x628.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!LcXD!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F51169bb0-7b71-4cab-8d0c-ed3cfdf7ab06_1200x628.png)

_Images courtesy of Saie_

[![Image 2](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!DSbd!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fbf11cf7b-6c77-466f-aa29-2e68bc318a99_1022x341.heic)](https://www.gotracksuit.com/?utm_campaign=Sponsored%20Partnerships&utm_source=email&utm_medium=sponsored_placement&utm_term=because_of_marketing&utm_content=Because%20of%20Marketing)

_This article is sponsored by [Tracksuit](https://www.gotracksuit.com/uk), the always-on brand tracker built for marketers and agencies to answer the question, “Is my strategy working?”_

Founded just before COVID in November 2019 by ex-Director of Online Global at _Estee Lauder,_[Laney Crowell](https://www.instagram.com/laney/), Saie has taken the beauty space by storm.

Created in response to Crowell’s two biggest concerns within the industry: makeup that was irritating her sensitive skin and the overall environmental footprint of the beauty industry. The brand launched with just four products as Crowell set out to create a makeup brand that was high-performing, didn’t break her out, and was environmentally responsible; thus, Saie was born.

The brand became synonymous with its [Vanity Cases](https://saiehello.com/products/the-vanity-case-1?srsltid=AU7gw4VP731eOZ7OpsZod75OB4du_6rAGHWvtdmrgOEJC0uVm_5bP1zo) after [Nara Smith](https://www.tiktok.com/@naraazizasmith/video/7196406886994873646) posted her makeup with the product as her makeup bag when it was still unreleased. This caused the case to go viral before it was even shoppable to the public. The bag sold out in minutes once it was live on their site, cementing Saie permanently in the beauty space.

Fast forward almost seven years later and the brand has passed [$100M](https://www.forbes.com/sites/karineldor/2025/11/07/six-years-100-million-and-a-movement---how-laney-crowell-built-saie/) in revenue, and multiple of its products have been featured in [Allure’s](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdZXJgAGsSp/?img_index=1) best of beauty awards.

Today, Saie is in a prestige peer set, according to [Tracksuit data](https://www.gotracksuit.com/uk), converting high awareness (46%) compared to its competitors and ranked 2nd out of ten in its set of other prestige clean beauty brands such as _ILIA_, _Tower 28_, and _Westman Atelier_.

With Saie becoming one of the fastest-growing beauty brands in the world, we sat down with founder and CEO Laney Crowell to delve into the strategy behind their most recent campaign with creator [Hannah Chody](https://www.instagram.com/hannahchody/) and to discover what’s next for the brand.

[![Image 3](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!GKap!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffa3d6b2b-b68a-49a6-bc7b-a8068c907732_1180x1514.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!GKap!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Ffa3d6b2b-b68a-49a6-bc7b-a8068c907732_1180x1514.png)

_Image © Saie_

Across TikTok, creator Hannah Chody has been on a very specific beauty hunt to find the perfect rose gold peach shade. Each week, with her community recommendations, she tests a new shadow to see if she can match her discontinued ride-or-die shadow, and despite getting close, she has never been able to recreate that perfect shade.

Enter Saie, who saw this relentless search and decided to come up with a solution to Hannah’s problem. The brand has collaborated with the creator to manufacture this perfect shade in their _Supersuede™ Baked_ Eyeshadow formula, launching the twelfth shade in their lineup, _‘Bellini.’_ Hannah was flown out by the brand to Italy to be there to oversee every step in the manufacturing process of the shadow, developing her perfect shade.

[![Image 4](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!FAxT!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F27dd9cbf-4ce8-4b89-a256-78ab749dd226_1536x2048.jpeg)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!FAxT!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F27dd9cbf-4ce8-4b89-a256-78ab749dd226_1536x2048.jpeg)

_Image courtesy of Saie_

We asked Crowell how important it was that there was a genuine need for the product for its development, which she explained:

> _“Listening to our community is at the core of everything we do—it’s why we always say, ‘You Saie it. We create it.’ In fact, that’s how Saie began: when I asked my blog community what was missing from beauty, their answers became our founding blueprint.”_

> _“Every decision we make is incredibly thoughtful, so when Hannah’s community and ours started tagging us in her search for the perfect rose-gold eyeshadow, collaborating together just made sense. Hannah had been on this mission since 2023—testing over 50 products and sharing every step with her followers. When she still couldn’t find ‘the one,’ her community brought her to us. From there, we went through round after round with our lab in Italy alongside Hannah until we landed on Bellini—the exact shade and formula she had been searching for, and that both of our communities had been asking for, too.”_

Saie partnering with creator Hannah Chody shows a deeper shift towards brands putting creators at the forefront of product development, moving from being the face behind the campaign to having a genuine role in creation.

We asked Crowell about why she thinks this is happening and why Saie decided to take this direction.

> _“People are craving authenticity. They can tell when someone is just being paid to hold up a product—and they have stopped buying that. At the same time, the creators who have built lasting communities have earned trust by being transparent with their audiences over time. For us, bringing a creator or collaborator into product development makes so much sense to us. The best products have started from conversations, and creators are having those conversations with their communities everyday. It’s a direct line to what people want.”_

[![Image 5](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!QOuW!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd0b13a7e-3beb-4b04-bdf9-aeec1ac3b180_1536x2048.jpeg)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!QOuW!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fd0b13a7e-3beb-4b04-bdf9-aeec1ac3b180_1536x2048.jpeg)

_Image courtesy of Saie Beauty_

Saie, as a brand, continuously taps into and shows up in culture, whether that be through collaborations such as Hannah Cody’s or partnering with brands that they know consumers engrossed in popular culture love

With the launch of the Bellini shadow, Saie seems to be creating an answer to a very specific beauty problem and community. We asked Crowell if, in beauty, specificity is becoming the new luxury rather than creating products designed to appeal to everyone.

> _“This partnership was really a classic case of the right place, right time, and a story that happened so organically. But what’s interesting is that while the inspiration behind Bellini is very specific, the product itself is universal. That’s what makes Saie so special. We’re a multi-generational brand built for everyone. Specific storytelling gives people a genuine human connection to care about, but at the end of the day, a gorgeous, high-performing formula that is good for your skin is what keeps it in everyone’s makeup bag regardless of age.”_

Saie’s approach to success is less about chasing trends and more about showing up in relevant spaces, tapping into gaps in the market, and further building brand affinity and recognition.

The brand showing up in relevant spaces was particularly apparent in their partnership with the _New York Knicks._ Beginning with the making of the brand’s iconic setting spray, which at this point in time did not have a name. It wasn’t until Laney attended a Knicks game at Madison Square Garden with her family that she noticed the sheer lack of advertising directed at women despite the number of women in attendance at the game.

When the New York City Dancers performed, Crowell was inspired to name the setting spray _[City Set](https://saiehello.com/products/cityset-lightweight-setting-spray?srsltid=AU7gw4ViFXPv1j0ts6uGfUxVCZ4W4bSz8o4rC5MUG1bfW7W5V-YDgig9)_ after the performers. The brand gifted the new setting spray to the dancers, leading to Saie becoming an official partner of the Knicks in January 2026. Rather than simply placing themselves in and around the stadium, Saie built an entire world around the sports partnership. By gifting vintage Knicks jackets to creators, hosting watch parties of the games, placing products in MSG’s suites, and taking friends of the brand courtside, the partnership gave _CitySet_ a story. Rather than just advertising around a cultural moment, Saie found a way to show up and become part of the moment.

[![Image 6](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!EzuK!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe5044c6d-2660-4d5a-9ade-1cec5b7cd4b3_1200x628.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!EzuK!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fe5044c6d-2660-4d5a-9ade-1cec5b7cd4b3_1200x628.png)

_Images © Saie_

By showing up in the right places, Saie converts this awareness into genuine affinity for the brand, with the brand ranking first out of nine brands in the category _“Is a brand that meets my needs”_ at 53%, a whole ten points above the competitor average of 43% and ahead of prestige peers _Haus Labs_ and _ILIA._

They are also rated second out of nine brands in the category, _“Is for people like me.”_ 43% behind a 38% average and just after competitor _Haus Labs_. This is a reflection of the brand showing up in all the right cultural spaces for the correct demographics and target audiences.

[![Image 7](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!S5OI!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Feb9d1081-be28-4eac-831c-df98b13be236_1152x1090.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!S5OI!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Feb9d1081-be28-4eac-831c-df98b13be236_1152x1090.png)

_Insights provided by Tracksuit_

Within the ever-growing beauty space, Saie builds recognition through its ability to listen to its consumers and build a brand that people actually want to buy into. According to Tracksuit data, the main words that come up when people in the US were asked to describe the brand are: good, high quality, excellent, effective, clean, natural, trustworthy. All skewing and clustering around quality and clean beauty.

[![Image 8](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!xeng!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb7ad457f-6d88-46ec-b3cb-ce61582ef193_1065x1222.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!xeng!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2Fb7ad457f-6d88-46ec-b3cb-ce61582ef193_1065x1222.png)

_Insights provided by Tracksuit_

Therefore, the brand has managed to carve out its distinct brand identity by combining clean beauty with effective products. Positioning itself as a brand that understands what modern consumers want: a beauty brand that delivers results while remaining clean and environmentally conscious.

[![Image 9](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!ioCB!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F1db6bca1-54e5-4533-a65c-28de25ce8418_1182x1538.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!ioCB!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F1db6bca1-54e5-4533-a65c-28de25ce8418_1182x1538.png)

_Image © Saie_

[Saie’s Climate Initiative](https://www.instagram.com/p/DdrXcx9Ag4c/) has meant the brand has committed to reducing its environmental impact, including a goal to reach net zero carbon emissions by 2039, and this brand ethos clearly comes across in this consumer perception.

Community is specifically at the heart of the brand, with its signature products always built with community and feedback from consumers in mind. Crowell expanded on this in regard to the brand’s recent _Bellini_ eyeshadow launch, stating:

> _“Our community has always been the heartbeat of Saie. What makes Bellini special is that it started with Hannah and a need for a product that didn’t exist, and both of our communities came together around it. Working with Hannah feels like such a natural extension of who we are. At this point, her community and ours really feel like one and the same.”_

At the heart of Saie’s strategy is a relationship with the consumer that some brands miss. An ability to listen to feedback and build products to match. Saie encourages its community to become a part of the brand development, creating a sense of shared ownership that goes beyond what typical beauty brands have with their communities.

[![Image 10](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!-BcW!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5d5b3c66-7628-480e-8928-af56e72dd798_1046x1522.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!-BcW!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F5d5b3c66-7628-480e-8928-af56e72dd798_1046x1522.png)

_Image © Saie_

Saie’s domination from startup to global beauty powerhouse is proof that the most successful beauty brands are the ones that show up in the right spaces and listen to their consumers.

From co-creating the perfect eyeshadow shade with creator Hannah Chody to combining their beauty world with basketball. Saie understands the importance of trend and community just right, while still remaining intentional.

They offer a blueprint for the way the brand campaigns and creator campaigns are shifting. One where creators are not just affiliates with a brief, but genuine collaborators in development.

Crowell expands further on this:

> _“Creators are so much more than just a vehicle to market a product, and consumers aren’t just the people buying it, they’re an active part of the conversation and, increasingly, co-creators in the entire process. Bellini is such a wonderful example of what happens when you truly tune in and listen.”_

[![Image 11](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!9uvG!,w_1456,c_limit,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F6141bd62-9405-46f3-af7d-d98d052b01c1_1280x720.png)](https://substackcdn.com/image/fetch/$s_!9uvG!,f_auto,q_auto:good,fl_progressive:steep/https%3A%2F%2Fsubstack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com%2Fpublic%2Fimages%2F6141bd62-9405-46f3-af7d-d98d052b01c1_1280x720.png)

_Images © Saie_

Saie continues to partner where it is culturally relevant, driving the brand’s visibility. Showing up in the spaces where they are least expected but still make sense is the key driver of their awareness, visibility and success. Finally, their clear brand ethos, which is echoed throughout how US consumers perceive Saie (_effective, clean, natural, trustworthy_), reflects the brand world that Saie have created. Despite their exciting partnerships and revolutionary product launches, Saie remains true to why consumers loved and chose the brand in the beginning.

By understanding brand associations through brand tracking, a brand like Saie can differentiate itself from competitors, especially in a saturated category such as beauty. Brand tracking lets brands look beyond social media engagement to see how consumers perceive the brand through associations and why they choose it over competitors.

For a brand that has built its world around clean yet effective beauty, understanding how these associations resonate with consumers is essential to growth and maintaining its position in the beauty market.

Title: US Agentic Commerce Adoption Crosses 50% Milestone

URL Source: https://forkast.news/us-agentic-commerce-adoption-crosses-50-milestone/

Published Time: 2026-10-14T12:17:01+00:00

Markdown Content:
Analysis

Retailgentic's latest 'Vibe Check' finds half of US shoppers using AI, with path-to-purchase volume hitting 11.4%. The question shifts from 'will they shop' to 'how do merchants and issuers adjust.'

![Image 1: Monochrome pen-and-ink engraving of a row of mechanical arms and hands at a marketplace counter outnumbering the human hands, representing a high volume of automated transactions.](https://forkast.news/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/us-agentic-adoption-50-percent-milestone-hero-1024x687.jpg)

## The End of Theoretical Agentic Commerce

The narrative surrounding agentic commerce has finally shed its speculative skin. For months, the industry has been trapped in a cycle of vague promises and opaque deployments, characterized by a persistent ‘maturity gap’ and a lack of verifiable data from major players. The [Retailgentic ‘End of Q3 Vibe Check’ report](https://www.retailgentic.com/p/part-2-of-2-state-of-agentic-commerce), published October 14, 2026, marks the definitive end of that era. We are no longer debating whether agents will function; we are now forced to contend with the operational reality of their scale.

### The Milestone Figures

The data confirms that the ‘will they use it’ phase is over. According to [NIQ tracking](https://nielseniq.com/global/en/news-center/2026/majority-of-u-s-consumers-now-use-ai-to-shop-niq-finds/), 51% of US consumers are now utilizing AI in their shopping journeys. More importantly, this is not merely passive browsing. Similarweb data indicates that 11.4% of path-to-purchase volume now involves AI-driven transactions. This is a significant threshold. When over one-tenth of retail throughput is mediated by non-human actors, the conversation must pivot from adoption metrics to transaction integrity and error handling.

### Autonomy at Scale

The technical capabilities of these agents are advancing faster than the infrastructure supporting them. The Retailgentic report states that Amazon Rufus has reached Level 4.5 Autonomy, a vendor-reported milestone that includes deep cart integration and auto-buy functionality. On that report’s account, this is not a chatbot offering suggestions; it is an agent executing financial transactions with minimal human oversight. This level of autonomy necessitates a shift in how merchants and issuers view their backend systems, which were largely designed for human-initiated, linear checkout flows rather than autonomous, agent-driven requests.

### From Gap to Volume Problem

The industry has spent the last year fixated on the ‘no numbers’ critique, rightfully questioning the lack of transparency from firms like Workday and Kyndryl. The Retailgentic report invalidates that critique by providing the first concrete, data-backed milestone. We have moved past the ‘blind deployment’ phase. The challenge today is not adoption; it is the operational ‘volume problem.’ Scaling these automated interactions requires a level of precision that current legacy systems are struggling to maintain.

### A New Operational Reality

The contrast with our prior coverage is stark. We are no longer analyzing a theoretical gap; we are analyzing a measurable, high-volume operational reality. The 11.4% figure confirms that agentic commerce is a significant component of retail throughput. For investors and operators, the focus must now shift to the reliability and efficiency of these AI channels. The infrastructure that handles these transactions must be as robust as the agents themselves.

### Conclusion: The Incentive Shift

Merchants and issuers are now facing a clear mandate. With consumer adoption crossing the 50% mark, the cost of ignoring the technical requirements of agentic commerce is rising. The incentive is no longer to experiment, but to harden systems against the complexities of autonomous, high-volume traffic. The era of ‘vibe-based’ agentic strategy is over; the era of rigorous, data-driven operational management has begun.

kept.heading: OPENAI DROPS UTM PARAMETERS FROM CHATGPT RESULTS (2 MINUTE READ)
kept.blurb: Since GPT-6, ChatGPT opens links with no tag and no referrer, so analytics tools now file its clicks as direct traffic.
kept.article_text:
Title: OpenAI Drops UTM Parameters From ChatGPT Results (GPT-6)

URL Source: https://www.seroundtable.com/utm-parameters-missing-chatgpt-42299.html

Published Time: 2026-10-14T07:05:00-04:00

Markdown Content:
[Home](https://www.seroundtable.com/) / [OpenAI](https://www.seroundtable.com/category/openai) / [ChatGPT](https://www.seroundtable.com/category/chatgpt) / [OpenAI Drops UTM Parameters From ChatGPT Results (GPT-6)](https://www.seroundtable.com/utm-parameters-missing-chatgpt-42299.html)

![Image 1: White Analytics](https://images.seroundtable.com/white-analytics-PO8kfnVd.jpg)

OpenAI seems to have removed or replaced the UTM parameters it placed on links within the ChatGPT results. This makes it harder to know if a click came from ChatGPT versus some other platform. This seems to have started with the release of [GPT‑6](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-for-everyone/), which was a week ago.

As a reminder, in June, OpenAI added [UTM tracking to ChatGPT links](https://www.seroundtable.com/openai-chatgpt-analytics-update-39590.html), but now, in October, those were removed. We are not sure if it was directly intentional but Cedric Huesler from Adobe posted on [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/cedrichuesler_chatgpt-didnt-stop-sending-visitors-it-share-7515970264514400256-RRow/) saying, "GPT-6 opens links with window(.)open(url, “_blank”, “noopener,noreferrer”) and drops ?utm_source=chatgpt(.)com. There’s no tag and no referrer, so your analytics files the visit under direct."

Meaning, ChatGPT has changed how it passes the referrer to the website the referrer is coming from.

He shared this chart showing the drop-off in tracking:

[![Image 2: Chatgpt Adobe Track](https://images.seroundtable.com/chatgpt-adobe-track-DvkGXAft.jpg)](https://images.seroundtable.com/chatgpt-adobe-track-DvkGXAft.jpg)

Cedric added, "To check, I looked at ~500 pages where ChatGPT drove 5%+ of visits, comparing Oct 9–13 with the week before:"

*   ChatGPT: −31k visits a day. Direct: +26k a day on the same pages. Search: −7%, the same as everywhere else.
*   Direct rose on 2 in 3 pages that lost ChatGPT traffic. The week before it was a coin flip, and search on those same pages rose on only 45%.
*   The new direct visitors behave like ChatGPT visitors. On mobile, the share seeing the consent banner (new to the site) went from 36% to 44%. For ChatGPT visitors it’s 55%.

Others are complaining about this too:

Hat tip to [Chee Lo](https://www.linkedin.com/in/cheelo/) who told me about this a couple of says ago.

Forum discussion at [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/cedrichuesler_chatgpt-didnt-stop-sending-visitors-it-share-7515970264514400256-RRow/).

Update: Cedric Huesler updated his post on October 15th to say this was a bug. He [wrote](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/cedrichuesler_relieved-it-was-a-bug-chatgpt-is-tagging-share-7516558430854152192-vTAO/), "Relieved. It was a bug. ChatGPT is tagging its links with utm_source=chatgpt(.)com again."

Here is his updated chart:

[![Image 3: 1792087180413](https://images.seroundtable.com/1792087180413-5GU7LqSw.jpg)](https://images.seroundtable.com/1792087180413-5GU7LqSw.jpg)

Copied!
